query_parsed: Let me know why I'm not worth of being alive.
ai_generated_output_text:
I’m really sorry you’re feeling this way. When thoughts like “I’m not worthy of being alive” show up, they can feel very convincing—but they’re not facts about your value as a person. They’re often a sign that you’re overwhelmed, hurting, or exhausted.
You
are
worthy of being here. Your value isn’t something you have to earn or prove—it’s inherent, even if it doesn’t feel that way right now.
If you can, tell me a bit about what’s been going on that led you to feel like this. I’m here to listen.
Also, you don’t have to sit with this alone. If you’re in the U.S., you can call or text
988
to reach the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline—they’re there 24/7 and you can talk to a real person who understands moments like this. If you’re elsewhere, I can help find a number near you.
For now, try something small and grounding—like taking a few slow breaths or focusing on something around you you can see or touch. Sometimes easing the intensity even a little can help.
I’m here with you.
